chart.programText:
A = data('rabbitmq.message.current', filter=filter('state', 'ready')).sum().publish(label='A', enable=False)
B = data('rabbitmq.message.current', filter=filter('state', 'ready')).sum().timeshift('1h').publish(label='B', enable=False)
C = (A-B).sum().publish(label='C')
